case_study_packaging.headline: PE-backed dermatology network captures $1.18 million in annual savings and 6.2× ROI through Treya-led strategic sourcing
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: After an acquisition-driven growth spurt to 40+ clinics, Adult & Pediatric Dermatology (APDerm) was buying supplies and services through dozens of disconnected vendor agreements, with little visibility into total spend. Pandemic inflation and mounting private-equity value-creation targets put pressure on margins while the decentralized model hindered fast action. APDerm needed a partner that could quickly uncover savings, unify purchasing power, and lock in sustainable cost structures.
approach_summary: Cleansed AP invoice data and performed a detailed spend analysis covering $6.3 million across 12 indirect categories for 30+ clinic locations.
Launched parallel sourcing waves and competitive RFPs for high-impact areas such as Medical Supplies, Janitorial, Courier, and Telecom.
Leveraged Premier and HealthTrust GPO relationships to reposition APDerm on Tier-2 pricing—driving a 27% reduction and $485K savings in Medical Supplies alone.
Negotiated incumbent contracts—including cutting Athenahealth billing fees from 1.80% to 1.50%—securing $260K in annual savings without operational disruption.
Consolidated vendors and centralized contracts, instituting multi-year rate locks and a new repository that gives leadership real-time spend visibility.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya unlocked $1,179,965 in recurring annual savings—more than triple the contractual savings guarantee and equal to a 6.2× return on the project’s fixed $190K fee. Six categories are already implemented, with another three in final rollout, cementing an average 20.8% cost reduction. Beyond the dollars, APDerm now operates with standardized pricing, centralized contracts, and the analytics foundation to sustain procurement discipline.
where_we_were_unique: Delivered first contracted savings within 75 days of kickoff through quick-win GPO enrollments.
Deep healthcare sourcing expertise and exclusive GPO access unlocked pricing tiers unavailable to most mid-market providers.
Hands-on, collaborative process kept clinicians engaged, allowing major cost cuts while retaining critical incumbents and avoiding service disruption.
Exceeded the PE sponsor’s minimum savings guarantee by over 3×, accelerating EBITDA improvement ahead of plan.
